environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on EC2 behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). PostgreSQL 14 with RLS policies enforcing tenant isolation via app.current_tenant session variable. No additional request filtering or sanitization middleware. The /search endpoint is publicly accessible. Response headers do not include Content-Security-Policy. X-XSS-Protection is not set.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB in TCP passthrough mode
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON users USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.network: public subnet, port 4000 exposed via ELB
